ns2:section.sectionText: The course will introduce modeling, estimation, and inference of quantile regression along with some useful applications. Computational and theoretical aspects will also be discussed. The course will further cover generalization to situations such as censoring and high dimensional covariates. Students are expected to give presentations and/or to do a project related to a topic covered in the class. Pre-requisites: STAT 527 (or STAT 425), and STAT 511 (or STAT 510). For Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration.
